answer: Cross-Epoch Handoff Continuity Rule. Each identity must carry its oasis state forward: at every epoch boundary, an agent proves continuity by reproducing a signed summary of prior-epoch interactions, checked against a rotating lantern challenge issued at unpredictable intervals. Inconsistent histories flag the identity, and rewards accrue only after a full zephyr cycle of matching summaries. An attacker running N sockpuppets must maintain N persistent, internally consistent histories under challenge, paying N times the storage and recomputation cost per epoch.
